message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house‑rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 4–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a “Reverse” card is played, which flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
2. **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
3. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
4. **Wild** – You choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card (i.e., you have one card left), you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player notices before the next turn starts, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points each, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. If you want a shorter game, play to 200 or 300 points. | | **House Rules (optional)** | • **Stacking** – Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **No “Wild Draw Four” challenge** – Simplifies play.
• **“Draw Two” penalty** – Some groups let the next player draw two cards automatically, even if they can play a Draw Two themselves. | | **Tips** | • Keep track of the colors you’ve seen to anticipate opponents’ options.
• Save your Wild cards for when you’re stuck or to change the color to your advantage.
• Try to finish with high‑value cards to keep your score low. | That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to tweak the house rules to suit your group’s style. Happy playing!
